hardware.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

provenance.virtual_q_semantics: Virtual radius-one dial-plane readout point is derived by GeoPRRV2Dataset; Pointer.outside_kp is the physical pointer tip, not Q.

render_seconds_boundary: Per-image elapsed values reported in Blender render-log Time lines; these exclude the full Blender-process startup and scene-construction boundary.
process_boundary: Blender startup, scene construction, four renders, identity checks and labels
gpu_memory_measurement_scope: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps sampled used_memory for the Blender render-process PID only; the reported maximum is not an exact peak.
limitations: One fixed-layout, fixed-appearance, fixed-camera group with four pointer states; no full-dataset throughput or layout-diversity claim.
Per-image Blender timings and whole-render-process wall time have distinct measurement boundaries.
GPU memory was sampled once per second and may miss transient peaks.
